contract.labels: Unshifted; logits[:,:-1] vs labels[:,1:], exactly one trainer shift
contract.pretrain: Separate domain/split streams; one BOS, every full work followed by EOS; cross-work causal attention allowed
contract.windows: 512 positions, stride511, overlap1; final short window retained; pad via training_data.pad_batch; drop_last=False
contract.sft: No packing/truncation; user/role/pad masked; all assistant content/EOT and final EOS supervised
contract.runtime_dtypes: Convert stored input_ids and labels to int64 for embedding/CE
contract.metadata: Sidecars only; source/topic multilabel strata are not additive

tokenizer_policy: Frozen BPE8192, no vocabulary training on new validation/test.
